name: 77630 · Orange, TX
findings: ZIP 77630 (Orange) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77630 (Orange) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77630 (Orange) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
